row.reason: Paylocity sells unified HR, payroll and finance software to mid-sized employers. Thryv sells marketing software and done-for-you marketing services to local service businesses. Both sell subscription SaaS to businesses, but the products serve different functions (employee management vs. customer acquisition) and the buyers differ (HR/finance buyers vs. small local business owners).
